title: Comfort of Scripture
definition: The comfort of Scripture is the encouragement, hope, correction, and peace God gives His people through His Word in weakness, grief, fear, and trial.
summary: God comforts His people through His Word without denying the reality of pain.
christFocus: Christ comforts His people as the suffering Savior, risen Lord, and Shepherd who speaks peace through His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture comforts by revealing God's presence, promises, character, salvation, and final victory. It does not offer shallow denial of pain.

The Word gives language for sorrow, strength for endurance, and hope beyond present suffering. Comfort from Scripture is rooted in truth, not empty optimism.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People in pain often need more than advice; they need God's voice. The comfort of Scripture matters because God's Word meets the afflicted with truth and compassion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Turn to Scripture in sorrow and fear. Let God's promises steady you, and share biblical comfort with others gently and patiently.
